name: @gjsify/webgl-darwin-arm64
description: darwin-arm64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/webgl. Installed automatically on darwin/arm64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.darwin-arm64: prebuilds.yml's `build-prebuilds-macos` matrix builds, load-tests and uploads it, but `commit-prebuilds` is main-only, so the directory lands on the first run after this change merges. `scripts/clear-committed-platform-exemptions.mjs` (wired into that job) deletes this entry in the same commit that adds the artifact, so it retires itself
